## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add toast
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `Toaster.gx` | `ui/toast/Toaster.gx` |
| `Toaster.fixtures.go` | `ui/toast/Toaster.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/toast/Toaster.gx"
package toast

props {
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node  = nil
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<div id="gx-toaster" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" class={gx.Cx("fixed right-4 bottom-4 z-50 flex w-72 flex-col gap-2", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>
  if p.Children != nil {
    {p.Children}
  }
</div>
```

```go title="ui/toast/Toaster.fixtures.go"
package toast

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var ToasterFixtures = gx.Fixtures[ToasterProps]{
	"WithToast": {Children: gx.ToastNode("Saved")},
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

## Usage

Render the toaster once, in the root layout.

```gx
<toast.Toaster />
```

An action pushes a toast through the adapter:

```go
return c.Toast("Saved")
```

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Render one toaster in the root layout.
- Keep the message short.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not render a toaster per page.
- Do not use a toast for a value the user must not miss. Use an alert.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| None | The toaster is an aria-live region and takes no focus. |
